Method of Attack: Payment card skimming via malicious JavaScript that collects credit card data from input fields on online stores and sends the stolen data encrypted to a private Telegram channel using a Telegram bot
Data exfiltration triggered when browser URL contains shopping site keywords and user validates purchase
Use of Base64 encoding to obfuscate bot ID, Telegram channel, and API requests
Eliminates need for traditional exfiltration infrastructure by using Telegram chat for data delivery
Impacted Systems: Online stores infected with the payment card skimmer variant
Attack Vector: Malicious JavaScript injected into online store websites
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Telegram bot tokens and channels for data exfiltration
Base64 encoded bot ID and API requests
Presence of malicious JavaScript with anti-analysis protections on shopping sites
